name: Ta Van
kicker: Valley walk to the far village
summary: Valley village about 12 km out: walk 8–12 km in 3–5 hours through the fields for a morning beyond town. The trail passes Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities, plus Giang Ta Chải bamboo and a view of Seo My Ty lake. Sleep out here when the terraces should be the morning. Ripe rice runs from about mid-August to October.
heroCaption: Houses in the terraces at Ta Van
body: Ta Van sits about 12 km from the town center. The walk through the valley is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours. You pass Giang Ta Chải bamboo and a view of Seo My Ty lake. The trail passes Mong, Giay, and Red Dao communities.

Ripe rice runs from about mid-August to October. Wider Sa Pa windows run from mid-August into November, so keep that span. Homestays in this valley are the stay outside the town hub. A streamside camp starts at 50,000 đồng a person. Ask before you book.

In 2025 the old Tả Van commune joined xã Tả Van with Hoàng Liên and Mường Hoa. The walk still uses the village name. The shared Lao Chải–Tả Van gate is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child.

figures.caption: Buffaloes and a walker in the Ta Van fields
figures.alt: A person with an umbrella and water buffaloes in green rice at Ta Van

gettingThere: Ta Van is about 12 km from the town center, at the far end of the Lao Chai walk. The trail is 8–12 km and takes 3–5 hours.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk the valley through Ý Linh Hồ and Lao Chai, 8–12 km in 3–5 hours, or ride about 12 km.

admissionNote: Lao Chải–Tả Van is 75,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child. A streamside camp starts at 50,000 đồng a person. Read the gate, and ask about the camp.
